Text: Got coffee with an old friend today. We laughed so much. It's been too long since we caught up. Feeling grateful for good people in my life.
Work was fine. Nothing exciting but got through my to-do list. Cooked a new recipe for dinner - turned out okay. Average day overall.
Finally finished that book I've been reading for weeks! The ending was perfect. Also the weather was beautiful - took a long walk in the park.
Woke up with a headache. Work was stressful with back-to-back meetings. Didn't get much done. Just felt off all day.
Terrible sleep last night. Anxious about some family stuff. Couldn't focus on anything. Just wanted the day to end.
Slept better. Talked to my mom - feeling less anxious about things. Small steps. Did some cleaning which weirdly helped my mood.
Great Saturday! Farmers market in the morning, then tried that new cafe everyone's been talking about. Met some friends for game night. Fun day.
Relaxing Sunday. Slept in, made pancakes. Caught up on laundry and chores. Nothing exciting but satisfying to be productive at home.
Monday energy is rough. Work wasn't bad, just felt sluggish. Made a simple dinner and watched TV. Nothing to complain about really.
Productive day at work - finished a big project early. Boss seemed impressed. Treated myself to takeout to celebrate.
Computer crashed and I lost some work. So frustrating. Had to stay late to redo things. Exhausted.
Better than yesterday. Backed up all my files. Work was steady. Learned my lesson about saving more often.
Presentation went amazing! Everyone loved my ideas. Got lots of positive feedback. Feeling validated and confident.
Nice Thursday. Grabbed lunch with a coworker - good conversation. Found out we have similar interests. Made plans to hang out outside work.
TGIF! Weekend plans are lined up. Got an unexpected bonus at work. Everything just feels right today. So grateful.
Went on a spontaneous road trip with friends. Beautiful scenery, good music, great company. These are the days I live for.
Tired from yesterday but in the best way. Spent today just relaxing and processing all the good vibes. Recharged.
Back to reality. Monday hit hard after such a fun weekend. Work was boring. Missing the freedom of the weekend.
Got some criticism on a project at work. Felt personal even though it probably wasn't. Mood was down all day.
Reflected on yesterday's feedback - it was actually fair. Made revisions. Growth mindset is hard but necessary.
Solid day. Work felt smoother. My revisions were approved. Cooked a really good dinner. Small wins add up.
Randomly ran into an old classmate at the grocery store. We grabbed coffee and talked for hours. Felt like no time had passed.
Got accepted to that program I applied for! I'm so excited. Celebrated with my family. They're so proud and supportive.
Still buzzing from yesterday's news. Started planning for the program. Feeling optimistic about the future.
Chill weekend day. Did some errands, organized my space. Productive without being stressful. Balanced.
Sunday evening dread is real. Prepped for the week. Not looking forward to Monday but trying to stay positive.
Mondays are the worst. So much to catch up on. Felt overwhelmed with everything on my plate. Need better time management.
Made a to-do list and actually stuck to it. Feels good to be organized. One day at a time.
Good day at work. Finally feeling caught up. Had a nice chat with a neighbor. Little social moments matter.
overall it was a good month. Ups and downs but mostly growth. Excited for what's next.
